title.en: GPT-4 Figure 4: academic and professional exams
title.zh: GPT-4 Figure 4：学术与职业考试表现

notes.en: Figure 4 from the GPT-4 Technical Report compares GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 percentiles across academic and professional exams. It became one of the release's most frequently reproduced evaluation graphics, but it summarizes benchmark results rather than model architecture; the existing original local explainer remains the single selected explanatory image, and no separate redistribution license is stated for the figure.
notes.zh: GPT-4 技术报告 Figure 4 比较 GPT-4 与 GPT-3.5 在多项学术和职业考试中的百分位表现，是发布时最常被引用的评测图之一。它说明基准结果而非模型架构；页面仍只选用现有本地原创解释图，论文未为该图单独声明再分发许可。

notes.zh: TED 具名人物页将格雷格·布罗克曼标为 OpenAI 联合创始人，发布清晰匹配的肖像，并链接其 TED2023 GPT-4 演示记录。该页支持身份与发布语境核验，不证明其为 GPT-4 作者；肖像未声明再分发许可。

title.zh: OpenAI 2017 标识 - Wikimedia Commons 镜像

notes.en: The Commons file page identifies OpenAI as both source and author of this 2017 wordmark-and-knot logo and links the original SVG. Commons marks the text logo public domain for copyright purposes while warning that it remains trademarked; any display must be neutral company identification and follow OpenAI's current brand rules. It is documented as a company-symbol candidate and is not added as a second selected event visual.
notes.zh: Commons 文件页将 OpenAI 标为这版 2017 字标与结形标识的来源和作者，并提供原始 SVG。Commons 将其按文字标识视为版权层面的公有领域，同时明确提示仍受商标限制；实际展示只能用于中性的公司识别，并应遵守 OpenAI 当前品牌规则。这里只记录为公司象征图片候选，不作为第二张选用的事件解释图。
